name: Connecting Ridge
note: Ridge between Shackleton and de Gerlache. Best-lit point within 3 km (PGDA average: Sun 88%, Earth 58%).

name: Shackleton Rim
note: Rim of Shackleton crater, next to permanent shadow. Best-lit point within 3 km (PGDA average: Sun 87%, Earth 54%).

name: de Gerlache Rim
note: Best-lit point within 3 km (PGDA average: Sun 83%, Earth 61%).

name: Malapert Massif
note: Tall massif facing Earth. Best-lit point within 3 km (PGDA average: Sun 59%, Earth 100%).

name: Nobile Rim 1
note: Best-lit point within 3 km (PGDA average: Sun 77%, Earth 67%).

name: Mons Mouton (Leibnitz beta)
note: Plateau; former VIPER target area. Best-lit point within 3 km (PGDA average: Sun 58%, Earth 100%).

name: Haworth
note: Best-lit point within 3 km (PGDA average: Sun 51%, Earth 65%).

name: IM-2 Athena
note: Mons Mouton. Landed on its side in a crater; ran out of power within a day.

name: IM-1 Odysseus
note: Malapert A.

name: Chandrayaan-3 Vikram
note: Shiv Shakti point.

name: Blue Ghost M1
note: Mare Crisium.

name: IM-3 (planned), Reiner Gamma
note: Planned Intuitive Machines IM-3 target: the Reiner Gamma swirl. Approximate centre of the target area, not an official landing point.

name: Schrodinger Basin (planned)
note: Planned far-side CLPS target area. Approximate basin centre, not an official landing point. Earth is never visible, so a relay is needed.

name: Blue Ghost M2 (planned), far side
note: Planned far-side landing carrying the LuSEE-Night radio telescope. Approximate location, not an official landing point. Earth is never visible.
